measurement.selection: same fixed first eight training questions
measurement.aggregation: median; plotted bands are IQR, not confidence intervals
measurement.backbone: activation gradients; pretrained parameter gradients disabled
measurement.inside_abstractor: per-layer parameter gradients, not per-layer symbol activation gradients
measurement.updates: actual AdamW update; includes momentum/adaptive scaling/weight decay
measurement.scale_adjustment: RMS(h)*RMS(dL/dh), descriptive only; not a directional derivative
